card.name: The letter e in step lists
card.fires_on: The letter e (or the bracket before f) used as the fifth item label in a lettered list of steps, right after the end of the previous step. It marks the point where the next list letter is expected.

modes.label: Step e in instructions
modes.description: The letter e starts the fifth lettered step in preparation or handling directions.

modes.label: Bracket before f
modes.description: An opening bracket after step e that leads to the letter f.
modes.example: Do not apply a new patch to the same location for at least 14 days.<< (>>f) May wear the patch during bathing

modes.label: Other lettered lists
modes.description: The letter e labels an item in a table or a question list.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue the list with the letter f and not a capital F.
card.plain: It spots the fifth lettered step in a list and prepares the next letter, f.
